title: Garam vs thanda mizaj, explained
caption:
'Iska mizaj bohat garam hai.' Okay, but which kind of garam?

In Unani tradition, temperament runs on two scales: garam or sard (warm or cool) and tar or khushk (moist or dry). Put them together and you get four mizaj, and suddenly a lot of family behaviour makes sense.

Traditional wellness wisdom, not medical advice.

Try the quick self-check on the last slide. Are you garam or thanda?
